main_text.l: quo Icil. expugnata elt Meccha, ubi Muslemínis præ-
cepit,ne in eâ quempiam occiderent, nisi qui ipsos
oppugnaret, & securitatem concessit omnibus, qui
Templum ingrederentur, & qui januâ occlusâ se
à pugnâ continerent,& qui aulæa Caabæ apprehende-
rent,illis tantùmmodo exceptis, qui damno ipsum
affecerant. Cúmque jam Abu Sofyan quidam è Mec-
cbæ primoribus, qui religionem Islamiticam præ me-
tu gladii amplexus fuerat, Mosleminorum copiis con-
spectis diceret Abbaso, Heus Abu fadl, certè magnum
jam evasit imperium nepotis tui: væ tibi, inquit ille.Imo
vero, Prophetia est. Respondit ille,Esto igitur[si libet]
Anno nono egressus est ad expugnandam Tabuc,
quæ regio est Græcorum, quâ in occupandâ, pugnâ
opus non habuit. Decimo demum instituit peregri-
nationem valedictionis, quoetiam pro Propheta se
venditans,in[regione]Yamama, Moseilema mendax,
librum Corano similem componere aggressus est, in
quo hæc habet. Vtique Deus benignitatem præstitit

page.notes: Running head and page number read from the scan; "13" at top right is partly worn, so the figure is uncertain. Italic/roman boundaries inside the long passage are approximate. Printed "Mofeilema" read as "Moseilema" (long s). The phrase "cutis" in the line "inter cuticulam" was split by the printer as "cuti-culam"; a likely misprint in the source, left as printed. "Abbaso" appears as printed. Two words in the Abu Fadl speech may be set in mixed type and should be checked against the original.
